DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯電話に届いた連絡について、ご相談ですね。どんな内容でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about a message received on your phone. What did it say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らないサービスの料金が未払いだと書かれています。使った覚えがないので、不安になって来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 利用した覚えのないサービスの未払い通知を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says I have not paid for a service I do not recognize. I do not remember using it, so I became worried and came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the unpaid bill notice for a service you do not remember using. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容を拝見して相談を進めましょう。連絡は今も残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the contents and discuss it. Do you still have the message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、消さずに残しています。昨日の夕方に届き、送信元の表示も見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残した本文と送信元と昨日夕方の受信を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I kept it without deleting it. It arrived yesterday evening, and the sender information is still visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you kept the message and sender information and received it yesterday evening. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受信の状況がわかりました。相手に返信したり、案内された操作をしたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I understand how you received it. Did you reply or carry out any of the operations it instructed you to do?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「心当たりがありません」とだけ返信しました。書かれたリンクは開かず、支払いもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返信はしたがリンクや支払いは行っていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I replied only, ‘I do not recognize this.’ I have not opened the link or made any payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you replied but neither opened the link nor paid. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返信した文と、まだ行っていないことを分けて伺いました。連絡の画面を確認するときは、リンクを操作せず内容を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have noted your reply separately from the actions you have not taken. When showing us the message, display its contents without activating the link.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け取った文と返信した文を別々に見せます。今ここで相手へ電話するのではなく、まず相談先を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受信と返信を提示し相手への電話前に担当を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show the received message and my reply separately. Before calling the sender here, I would first like to find out whom I should consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the received message and your reply and ask which staff member to consult before calling the sender. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談の内容に合う担当を確認します。今見える情報だけで、相手の正体や請求の扱いを断定せず調べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check which staff member handles this kind of consultation. Let us investigate without deciding who the sender is or how to treat the claim based only on what is currently visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 届いた時刻と本文と自分の返信を伝えます。追加で連絡が来たら、消さずに内容を残して担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻と内容を残して担当へ相談する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain when it arrived, its contents, and my reply. If further messages arrive, I will keep their contents without deleting them and consult the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will keep the times and contents and consult the staff member. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を整理していただき、ありがとうございます。担当への案内を確認しますので、画面をそのままにしてお待ちください。それでは、引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for organizing the details. Please leave the screen as it is while I check where to refer you. I will now hand this over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の発送相談ですね。箱の中には何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice on sending a parcel. What is inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で作った陶器の小鉢が二つです。紙を巻きましたが、箱の中で二つが触れているので心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小鉢二つが箱内で触れる状態を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two small ceramic bowls I made myself. I wrapped them in paper, but I am worried because they touch each other inside the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the two small bowls touching inside the box. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 梱包の状態と発送条件を確認しましょう。箱はもう閉じてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the packaging and shipping conditions. Have you closed the box already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ閉じていません。少し動かすと中で音がするので、このまま出してよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱を閉じる前に動く状態で出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not closed it yet. I hear something moving inside when I move it a little, so I would like to ask whether I can send it this way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask before closing the box whether it can be sent while the contents move. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 梱包を見ながら担当へ確認します。割れ物と伝えるだけで破損が起きないという保証にはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the responsible staff member while we look at the packaging. Simply declaring the contents fragile does not guarantee they will not be damaged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示だけに頼らず、梱包も見直します。入れ直した場合は、箱の大きさや重さを測り直す必要もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 梱包を変更した後の箱の大きさと重さを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will review the packaging rather than relying only on the label. If I repack it, will the box dimensions and weight need to be measured again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the box dimensions and weight after changing the packaging. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発送時の状態で確認しましょう。箱が変われば条件も変わる可能性があるため、整えてから見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check it in the condition in which it will be sent. A different box may change the conditions, so we will look after you have prepared it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家で梱包を直してから持ってきます。送る相手には、確認が済むまで発送日が決まっていないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 梱包を直し発送未確定だと相手へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will fix the packaging at home and bring it back. I will tell the recipient that the shipping date is undecided until the checks are complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will fix the packaging and tell the recipient that shipment is not yet confirmed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件と費用を確認してからご判断ください。内容の説明は、今のように陶器が二つと具体的に伝えていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please decide after checking the conditions and cost. You can describe the contents specifically as two ceramic items, just as you have now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの陶器と梱包の状態を説明し、整えた箱の大きさと重さで相談します。破損しないと決めつけず、条件を聞いてから送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 整えた箱と具体的な内容で条件を確認して送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will describe the two ceramic items and their packaging and ask based on the dimensions and weight of the prepared box. I will ask about the conditions before sending it, without assuming it cannot break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the conditions using the prepared box and a specific description of the contents before sending it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、梱包が整ったら再度お持ちください。発送前にご相談いただけてよかったです。陶器が無事届くといいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it back once the packaging is ready. I am glad you asked before shipping it. I hope your ceramics arrive safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みについてですね。振込先がわかる案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a bank transfer. Do you have instructions showing the recipient account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講座の受講料を振り込みたいです。自分でメモしましたが、支店名を書き忘れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受講料の振込先で支店名が欠けている可能性を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to transfer a course fee. I copied the details into a note, but I may have forgotten the branch name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the branch name may be missing from the course fee transfer details. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモだけで進めず、元の案内と照らしましょう。案内そのものを確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare your note with the original instructions before proceeding. Can you check the instructions themselves?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯電話に案内があります。銀行名と口座番号は見えますが、支店の欄が画像の端で切れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 銀行名と番号は読めるが支店欄が切れていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the instructions on my phone. I can see the bank name and account number, but the branch field is cut off at the edge of the image.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bank name and number are readable but the branch field is cut off. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切れた部分を推測せず、講座の担当へ完全な案内を確認してください。受取人の名義も照らしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask the course organizer for the complete instructions without guessing the missing portion. Check the account holder's name as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 講座の名前と受取人の名前が違って見えます。その違いも担当へ聞いてから、振込先を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 講座名と受取人名の違いを担当へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The course name and the recipient's name appear different. I would like to ask the organizer about that difference before confirming the transfer details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the organizer about the difference between the course name and recipient's name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報がそろってからご相談できます。費用についても、利用する方法などを確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can discuss the transfer once all the necessary information is available. We will also explain the fees after checking the method you will use and other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受講料とは別に振込の費用を知りたいです。まだ実行せず、どの段階で総額を確認できるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受講料と振込費用を分け総額を知る段階を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to know the transfer fee separately from the course fee. Before making the transfer, please tell me at what stage I can check the total amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the course fee from the transfer fee and ask when you can see the total. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実行前に金額と費用を確認する方法を担当がご案内します。確認画面や案内の内容を読まずに進めないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff member will explain how to check the amount and fees before making the transfer. Please read the confirmation screen and instructions before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 支店の情報と受取人を講座側に確認し、受講料と振込費用を分けて聞きます。総額と宛先がわかるまで実行しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支店と名義と金額と費用がわかるまで待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm the branch details and recipient with the course organizer and ask separately about the course fee and transfer fee. I will not make the transfer until I know the total and destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait until the branch, account holder, amount, and fees are clear. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認前に不足に気づけましたね。完全な案内が届いたら、メモと一緒にお持ちください。またのご相談をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You noticed the missing information before proceeding. Please bring the complete instructions together with your note when you receive them. We look forward to helping you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の前に袋のご希望を伺います。お持ちの袋だけでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before checkout, may I ask about bags? Will the bag you brought be enough?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持ってきた袋に全部は入りそうにありません。重い物を分けたいので、追加の袋を一つ相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋に収まらず重い物を分けるため一袋を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not think everything will fit in my bag. I would like to separate the heavy items, so could I ask about getting one additional bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for one bag because your own bag is too small and you want to separate the heavy items. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の大きさと条件をご案内します。購入を希望される場合は、会計に含む金額も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain the bag sizes and conditions. If you wish to purchase one, let us also confirm the amount included in your bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きさを見てから決めたいです。使える袋の値段を含めた合計も、支払う前に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きさと袋代を含めた支払前の合計を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to decide after seeing the size. Please also tell me the total including the price of a suitable bag before I pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the size and total including the bag charge before paying. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合計を確認してから進めます。お支払いは、どの方法を希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will proceed after checking the total. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯電話で払うつもりでしたが、電池が少ないです。使える方法を確認して、難しければ現金にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電池が少ないため利用方法と現金への変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I planned to pay with my phone, but its battery is low. I would like to check the available methods and use cash if paying by phone is difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your battery is low and ask about available payment methods and changing to cash. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使える方法をご案内します。操作を始めて途中で画面が消えた場合は、次の支払いをする前に声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain the available methods. If the screen goes off during the payment operation, please speak to us before making another payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で消えたら自分でやり直さず、会計の状態を確認してもらいます。今は現金で払うほうに決めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面が消えたら再操作前に状態を聞き今は現金を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it goes off, I will ask you to check the payment status instead of trying again myself. May I choose to pay cash now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will ask about the status before retrying if the screen goes off and choose cash now. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現金でのご希望として承ります。袋を含む合計を見てから、お支払いをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood, you would like to pay cash. Please check the total including the bag before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 追加の袋を一つ選び、合計を確認して現金で払います。持参袋と分けて詰め、重い物を一袋に集めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加袋を選び総額を見て現金で払い荷物を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose one additional bag, check the total, and pay cash. I will divide the items between it and my own bag instead of putting all the heavy items in one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose an additional bag, check the total, pay cash, and divide the items. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、選んだ袋を会計に含めます。お支払い後にレシートと商品もご確認ください。お買い上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will include the selected bag in your bill. Please check your receipt and purchases after paying. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図の距離をご覧になっていますね。どちらまで歩くか検討中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the distance on the map. Where are you considering walking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 久しぶりなので短い散歩にしたいです。この距離が往復なら歩けそうですが、片道なのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 短い散歩のため表示が片道か往復かを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not been walking for a while, so I would like a short walk. I think I could manage this distance if it is round trip, but is it one way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the displayed distance is one way or round trip so you can plan a short walk. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の説明を確かめましょう。この矢印は、現在地から目的地までの区間を示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the explanation. This arrow indicates the stretch from your current location to the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 戻る分は別に考えるのですね。往復の距離だと思っていたので、遠い目的地は今回はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰りの距離が別なので遠い目的地をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I need to allow separately for the return journey. I thought it was the round trip distance, so I will skip the faraway destination this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will skip the distant destination because the return distance is additional. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰りの分も含めた候補にしましょう。途中で休む場所も図で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us choose an option that also accounts for the return. We can check places to rest along the way on the map too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 近い休憩場所までの区間で考えたいです。そこに行ったあと、元の入口へ戻る道も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩場所までの道と元の入口への戻り方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to consider the stretch to a nearby rest area. I would also like to see the route back to the original entrance from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the route to the rest area and the way back to the original entrance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口と休憩場所の表示を照らしましょう。道の状態は現地で確認し、疲れたら手前で戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us compare the entrance and rest area signs. Check the path conditions on site and turn back earlier if you feel tired.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩場所まで行かなければいけないわけではないのですね。途中で戻る場合も、同じ入口の表示をたどります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩場所に届かなくても入口の表示で引き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I do not have to reach the rest area. If I turn back partway, I will also follow the signs for the same entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will follow the entrance signs back even if you do not reach the rest area. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、入口名を覚えておいてください。戻る時間に余裕を残し、距離を達成することだけを目標にしないで歩きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please remember the entrance name. Leave enough time to return, and do not make completing the distance your only goal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 片道表示に帰りの分も考え、近い区間だけ歩きます。途中で疲れたら引き返し、休憩と帰る時間を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰りと休憩の分を考え疲れたら短くして戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will allow for the return in addition to the one way distance and walk only a nearby stretch. If I become tired, I will turn back and leave time for resting and returning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Allow for resting and returning, shorten the walk if tired, and turn back. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理のない範囲が決まりましたね。現地の表示も見ながら、久しぶりの散歩を楽しんでください。お気を付けてどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have settled on a manageable plan. Please check the signs along the way and enjoy your first walk in a while. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行画面を見てお急ぎのようですね。どちらの方向へ向かう便をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You seem in a hurry after looking at the service display. Which direction does your service go?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 山側へ行く便です。遅れと出ているので、勤務先に遅刻すると連絡しようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 山側へ行き遅延を見て勤務先に遅刻を知らせようと考えたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It goes toward the mountains. I saw a delay notice and thought I would tell my workplace I would be late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are heading toward the mountains and considered reporting lateness after seeing a delay. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用画面では、上の行は海側、下の行が山側です。遅れの文字はどちらの行にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this practice display, the upper row is toward the sea and the lower row is toward the mountains. Which row has the delay notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上の行でした。時刻が似ていたので、自分の便だと思ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遅れは上の海側の行で似た時刻から自分の便と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was the upper row. The times were similar, so I assumed it was my service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the delay was on the upper, seaward row and the similar time made you think it was your service. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 行き先の方向も含めて見直しましょう。下の行には、今のところ変更の案内が載っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look again, including the direction. At present, the lower row shows no notice of a change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下の行を見ます。変更が載っていなくても、確実にその時刻に着くとまでは言えないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 山側を読み変更表示なしでも到着確約にはならないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will look at the lower row. Even without a change notice, that does not guarantee arrival at that exact time, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the mountainward row and confirm that no change notice does not guarantee the arrival time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示はその時点の案内です。出発までに更新があれば、改めて確認してください。乗り場は把握していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The display gives information at that point in time. Please check again if it updates before departure. Do you know where to board?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内紙にある乗り場と画面を照合します。勤務先には、間違った行を見たため遅刻の連絡はまだしないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内紙と画面を照合し見間違えた表示を根拠に遅刻の連絡をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will compare the boarding location on the information sheet with the display. Since I looked at the wrong row, I will not tell my workplace I will be late yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the information sheet and display and explain that you will not report lateness based on the misread notice. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗る便が変わったり到着の予定に影響が出たりしたら、必要な連絡を考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your service changes or your expected arrival is affected, consider making any necessary contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 山側の便と乗り場を確かめ、変更の案内が出たら勤務先へ状況を伝えます。海側の表示とは分けて見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 山側便と乗り場を確認し変更があれば勤務先へ伝え方向ごとに表示を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the mountainward service and boarding location and tell my workplace the situation if a change is announced. I will read it separately from the seaward information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the mountainward service and boarding location, report changes to work, and distinguish the directions on the display. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、画面の方向欄を見ながら乗り場へお進みください。それでは、お気をつけてご出発ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed to the boarding location while checking the direction column. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約をご希望ですね。相談する内容と、参加を考えている方を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to book a consultation. May I ask what it concerns and who is planning to attend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 届いた書類の意味を相談したいです。日本語の説明を友人に手伝ってもらいたいので、一緒に来てよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 書類説明を友人に手伝ってもらいたいので一緒に来られるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to ask about the meaning of some documents I received. I want a friend to help me understand the Japanese explanation, so I would like to know whether we can come together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your friend can accompany you to help with the document explanation. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同席については相談内容に合わせて担当者に確認します。友人の方が来られる時間は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will ask the responsible staff member about having someone accompany you, depending on the consultation. Is your friend's availability fixed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は午後の最初の一時間だけ空いています。予約枠がその中で終わるか、案内からわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人は午後最初の一時間だけで予約がその内に終わるか不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend is available only for the first hour of the afternoon. The information does not tell me whether the appointment will finish within that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend has only the first hour of the afternoon and you do not know if the appointment will finish then. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 枠の長さと実際の相談に必要な時間は分けて確かめましょう。書類は一種類だけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the appointment slot length separately from the time actually needed for the consultation. Is there only one kind of document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内と別紙の二種類です。全部読むより、わからない三つの欄を先に質問したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内と別紙の二種があり不明な三欄を先に質問したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two: the instructions and a separate sheet. Rather than reading everything, I would like to ask about three unclear fields first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the instructions and a separate sheet and want to ask first about three unclear fields. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 三つの欄がわかるように印を付け、予約の相談でその希望を伝えましょう。同席できるかの返事も必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Mark the three fields clearly and explain that preference when discussing the booking. You also need an answer on whether your friend can attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 印を付けて持参します。友人が同席できない場合は、説明の方法をどうするか担当者へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 欄に印を付け同席できなければ説明方法を担当へ相談したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will mark them and bring them. If my friend cannot attend with me, I would like to ask the staff member how the explanation can be provided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will mark the fields and ask about the explanation method if your friend cannot attend. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場合の説明方法も、ここで決めずに確認しましょう。候補の日時を一つだけにせず、お持ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check that method too rather than deciding it here. Could you bring more than one possible date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人の空き時間と別の日の候補を用意します。同席と時間の返事がそろってから予約を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の時間と別日候補を用意し同席と所要時間の回答後に予約する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will prepare my friend's available time and alternatives on other days. I will decide on the booking after receiving answers about attendance and the time required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare your friend's availability and other dates and book after answers about attendance and duration. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、印を付けた書類と候補日時を基に担当へおつなぎします。予約が決まりましたら、その案内に沿ってお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer you to the responsible staff member using your marked documents and proposed dates. Once the booking is confirmed, please follow the instructions when you come.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計後の書類をお受け取りになりましたね。内容について確認したい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have received the documents after payment. Is there anything in them you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日付が二つあって迷っています。今日の領収書と、次に来るための案内が同じ束に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受領書類に今日の領収書と次回来訪案内が両方あるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am confused because there are two dates. Does this bundle include both today's receipt and instructions for my next visit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the documents include both today's receipt and instructions for the next visit. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の束では、一枚目が領収書で二枚目が次回の案内です。二枚目の見出しを確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this practice bundle, the first sheet is the receipt and the second is the next visit instructions. Could you check the heading on the second sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 次回案内とあります。領収書の今日の日付を、次の予約日だと写しかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 次回案内の見出しを読み今日の領収日を予約日と誤記しそうだったと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says ‘Next visit information.’ I almost copied today's date from the receipt as my next appointment date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the next visit heading and explain that you almost mistook today's receipt date for the appointment date. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写す前に区別できましたね。二枚目の日時について、読めない文字はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You distinguished them before copying. Is there anything you cannot read in the date and time on the second sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時刻の前に書かれた受付という言葉です。診察が始まる時刻と同じだと思ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付という表記が診察開始と同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is the word ‘reception’ before the time. Should I assume that is also the time the medical consultation starts?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether ‘reception’ means the same as the start of the medical consultation. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここでは受付の時刻として書かれているので、診察開始を意味すると決めずに担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is written as the reception time here, so let us ask the responsible staff member without assuming it means the consultation starts then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。手帳には受付時刻として書き、診察開始とはまだ書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当へ確認し手帳には受付時刻と書いて開始時刻と断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask the staff member. I will write it as the reception time in my planner and avoid calling it the consultation start time for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will ask the staff member and record reception time without assuming consultation start time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 領収書は次回案内と別に保管すると取り違えにくいですね。受け取った書類に不足がないかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keeping the receipt separately from the next visit instructions will help prevent confusion. We will also check that no documents are missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書を会計用の袋へ入れ、次回案内は手帳に挟みます。日時の意味を確認してから予定を写します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書を会計袋で次回紙を手帳に保管し日時の意味の確認後に写すと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the receipt in my payment documents pouch and the next visit sheet in my planner. I will copy the schedule after confirming what the date and time mean.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the receipt in the payment pouch and next visit sheet in the planner and copy after checking the date and time meanings. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、案内の時刻を担当と確認してからお帰りください。どうぞ書類をお忘れにならず、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please confirm the indicated time with the staff member before leaving. Do not forget your documents, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした物について伺います。ご自身の持ち物でしょうか、それともお借りになった物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me ask about the missing item. Does it belong to you, or did you borrow it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から借りたカメラです。返そうとしてかばんを開けたら、入っていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人のカメラを返すためかばんを開けたらなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a camera I borrowed from a friend. When I opened my bag to return it, it was not there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the friend's camera was missing when you opened your bag to return it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 借りた物なのですね。最後にカメラを見た場所は、返すためにかばんを開けた場所と同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it is borrowed. Was the place you last saw it the same place where you opened your bag to return it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。最後に見たのは昼に座ったベンチで、ないと気づいたのは帰宅してからです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昼のベンチで最後に見て帰宅後に不在を知ったと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I last saw it on a bench where I sat at midday, and I noticed it was missing after getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you last saw it on the bench at midday and noticed it missing after returning home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に見た所と気づいた所を分けて記録しましょう。機種名や色など、説明できることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us record the last place you saw it separately from where you noticed. Can you describe the model, color, or other details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 黒い小型のカメラで、青いひもが付いています。機種名は借りた時に聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒い小型と青いひもは覚えているが機種名は聞いていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is a small black camera with a blue strap. I did not ask the model name when I borrowed it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you remember a small black camera and blue strap but did not ask its model. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不明な機種名は推測せず、その特徴を伺います。友人へ機種名や写真を確認することはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will note those features without guessing the unknown model. Can you ask your friend for its model name or a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人へ連絡できます。写真を送ってもらい、私が覚えている青いひもと一緒に説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ機種と写真を聞き覚えたひもと合わせ説明したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can contact my friend. I would like them to send a photo so I can describe it together with the blue strap I remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask your friend for the model and photo and describe them together with the strap you remember. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真が届いたら、覚えていた特徴と照らしましょう。カメラのほかに一緒になくなった物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: When the photo arrives, let us compare it with the features you remember. Did anything else go missing with the camera?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ほかに、なくなったと気づいた物はありません。借りた物であること、昼のベンチで見たこと、家で気づいたことを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他は今のところなく借り物で昼にベンチで見て家で気づいたと分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not noticed anything else missing. I will explain separately that it was borrowed, that I saw it on the bench at midday, and that I noticed at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain separately that nothing else is currently missing, it was borrowed, you saw it on the bench at midday, and noticed at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順序で相談内容を整理します。それでは、友人からの資料も確認しながら届け出の案内を続けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will organize the details in that order. Let us continue the reporting instructions while also checking the materials from your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票を二枚お持ちですね。両方の荷物のお受取りを相談したいということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two missed delivery slips. Would you like to ask about receiving both parcels?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二個あると思って来ましたが、二枚の番号が同じに見えます。同じ荷物の案内か確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二個と思ったが番号が同じに見えるので同一荷物か確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came thinking there were two, but the numbers on the slips look the same. Could you check whether they refer to the same parcel?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought there were two parcels but the numbers look the same and ask whether it is one parcel. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号と日付を合わせて確認しましょう。一枚ずつ、どの日に届いた票なのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the numbers together with the dates. Please tell me which day each slip arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚目は昨日で、二枚目は今日です。今日は玄関にあったので、前の票と並べて気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一枚は昨日で他は今日玄関にあり並べて番号に気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The first was yesterday and the second today. Today's was at the entrance, and I noticed when I put it beside the earlier one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that one was yesterday and the other was at the entrance today and you noticed the numbers when comparing them. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この練習場面では、番号を担当者が照合して件数を確かめます。今すぐ二個と決めず、お受取りの希望も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this practice situation, the staff member compares the numbers to confirm the number of parcels. Without deciding there are two yet, let me also ask how you wish to receive them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 件数がわかったら窓口で受け取りたいです。ただ、二枚目には別の窓口名が書いてあるように見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 件数確認後に窓口受取を希望するが二枚目の窓口名が違うようだと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Once the number is confirmed, I would like to collect at a counter. However, the second slip seems to name a different counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want counter collection after the number is confirmed but the second slip seems to name a different counter. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取場所の欄も確認が必要ですね。ここで受け取れると約束せず、記載と担当の案内を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also need to check the collection location field. Let us confirm the writing and staff instructions without promising that you can collect it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 場所が違えば、その窓口へ行く前に受付時間も確認します。今日は票を二枚とも見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別窓口なら時間も先に調べ今日は二票とも提示すると思いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the location differs, I will check its opening hours before going to that counter. Today I would like to show both slips.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will check hours before going to a different counter and want to show both slips today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二枚とも照合できるようにしてください。確認後に、使う票と今回の案内を取り違えないよう整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make both slips available for comparison. After checking, let us arrange the slip to use and the current instructions so they do not get mixed up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚を見せて件数と場所を確認し、案内が決まってから受取先へ行きます。二個だとはまだ決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二票で個数と場所を確認し決定後に受取先へ行き二個と断定しないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show both slips to confirm the number and location and go to the collection point after the instructions are settled. I will not assume there are two parcels yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will check the number and location using both slips and go after confirmation, without deciding there are two. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、番号と窓口の表示を担当へおつなぎします。お受取りの案内を確認するまで、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass the numbers and counter information to the responsible staff member. Please wait here until we confirm the collection instructions.
